name: estandar-versiones-asi
title_zh: 版本号报上来先查组织 ASI 政策再放行的门卫
tagline_zh: 别人问依赖版本随口答，你这边每个版本号都要过一遍组织私有 ASI v6.4 技术政策。不合规的直接拦下。
tagline_en: When others quote versions off the cuff, yours pass through an org-private ASI v6.4 policy check first.
desc_en: Trigger: ASI versions, homologated technology, dependency version, framework version. Enforce organization-private ASI v6.4 technology policy.
why_zh: 把分散在文档里的版本约束变成一道自动闸门。不是查最新版，是查组织允许的版本——政策一变。
why_en: Turns scattered version rules into one automatic gate. Not latest-version lookup but org-allowed versions — policy updates.
limit_zh: 只认 ASI v6.4 政策格式，其他版本政策需先转换。只校验版本号字符串，不解析代码仓库实际依赖树。
limit_en: Only ASI v6.4 policy format; others need conversion. Validates version strings only, not actual dependency trees. Policy file must be at an.
title_en: Version gatekeeper that checks every dependency against.
